concern: paun — پاؤں (paana root) is doubled elsewhere in the corpus (paaon at 18:19, 19:25, 20:72); single-a spelling is inconsistent (R1). ("laun" in the same verse is a separately pending spelling, not raised here.)
enaayat — عنایت is spelled "inaayat" elsewhere in the corpus (18:82, 18:85); "enaayat" (with e) does not match either the established spelling or the pending variant "inayat"
karden (both instances) is subjunctive (kar+den), not future tense; R6 joins only future verbs, and elsewhere in the corpus this same construction is written as two words (e.g. "kar den")
